TreasonOfTzeentch.description:
Creates a copy of an enemy character in a random hex within 3 hexes of <style="Faction_ThousandSons">Magnus</style>. The copy fights on the side of Magnus and has <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of the original character's maximum <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. All other stats and ability levels are identical.
When a character attacks Magnus while the clone of that character is on the battlefield, the character and the clone swap places.
